constraints.condition: Uniform-reflectivity reference ellipsoid from published lightcurve amplitude; minimum a/b, not an exact recovered outline.
constraints.sizeInterpretation: Brightness-based size assuming geometric albedo 0.06; uncertainty is source sensitivity, not measured axes.

assumptions: Select published lower-limit equatorial ratio, not a full recovered shape.
Reference radius treated as equal-volume display scale only.

Partial observed south-ecliptic pole latitude and retrograde sense are preserved. Exact pole longitude and current phase remain unknown; ecliptic south is a representative display convention, not the full measured pole. Author body-page pole cells are blank; the primary paper supplies this partial constraint.
approximation.qualification: Published south-ecliptic pole latitude approximately -85 ± 15 degrees and sidereal period are useful; do not invent a pole longitude or native convex mesh.

photometryCheck.interpretation: Algebraic consistency only; not a fit to observed Cassini lightcurves or a measured volume.
